_meta.describes: How much a cap breaker raises an attribute, for every starting rating and each of the five permitted applications.
notes: An attribute accepts a maximum of five cap breakers and the gain shrinks with each one. Lower-rated attributes gain far more per breaker.

The gain depends on the whole build, because it is computed against the build's winning archetype. Hence two scenarios: `isolated` (all other attributes at the 25 floor) and `near_caps` (all others at their physical cap).
Cap breakers raise an attribute towards its physical cap but never past it.
Sparse by design: 13,280 of a possible 15,750 rows. Combinations with no headroom left are absent.
_meta.verification: Audited invariants: gains are non-negative; the five applications are non-increasing for every (scenario, attribute, rating) sequence; and in the isolated scenario rating + gain never exceeds the attribute's ceiling at the reference body, confirming breakers approach the physical ceiling without passing it.
